stories.title: Welsh Government takes more direct role at Betsi Cadwaladr after health board’s own ‘failed’ efforts

stories.title: Investment Zone grants set to create 79 jobs across Flintshire
stories.summary: Fifteen businesses across Flintshire have shared £898,461 in grants from the Flintshire and Wrexham Investment Zone, with the funding expected to unlock a further £1.2 million in private sector investment. stories.title: Public Health Wales survey reveals scale of child poverty across Wales
stories.summary: Nearly one in three children in Wales were living in poverty in 2023-24, according to Department for Work and Pensions figures cited in research published by Public Health Wales.
